query:
insert into game_membership (game_id, account_id)
         select $1, $2
         where not exists (
             select 1 from game_membership where game_id = $1 and account_id = $2
         )
         and (
             select count(*) from game_membership where game_id = $1
         ) < (
             select max_players from game where id = $1
         )
         returning *
